title: One of the 72 posts is not live: 'Top Questions Consumers Have About Private Label Supplements' is still DRAFT and its URL is hijacked by a domain-less redirect into a 404
evidence: API: state=DRAFT, currentState=DRAFT, currentlyPublished=false, publishedAt=null (the other 71 are PUBLISHED). So the group is 71 published + 1 draft, not 72 published. curl without -L returns 301 to https://www.praxerasupplements.com/private-label/managing-the-top-3-risks-when-selling-private-label-supplements, which returns 404. The redirect is rule 208573973878 (created 2026-03-02), routePrefix '/blog/top-questions-consumers-have-about-private-label-supplements' with NO domain and isOnlyAfterNotFound=false, so it fires on praxerasupplements.com too. It is the only one of 255 domain-less rules that shadows a Praxera blog slug. Live post 220637279592 (managing-the-top-3-risks...) links to this dead URL twice.
proposed_fix: (a) Scope redirect 208573973878 to blog.davincilabs.com (routePrefix 'http://blog.davincilabs.com/blog/top-questions-...') instead of a bare path, or delete it; (b) publish post 220638601745 once (a) is done; (c) re-point the two links in post 220637279592.

title: 10 live posts present Praxera as the manufacturer / owner of facilities — forbidden brand language
evidence: Verbatim from live post bodies: 220638601792 — 'all of our facilities are FDA-certified. Our industry-leading manufacturing facilities produce over 250 doctor-formulated vitamins and supplements.'; 220637272704 — 'Praxera operates an FDA-registered, NSF GMP 455-2 certified facility'; 220637279586 — 'Custom liquid supplements ... are manufactured at Praxera to be GMP Certified'; 220637279650 — 'Some manufacturers (like Praxera) specialize in private labeling' and 'Established private label manufacturers like Praxera offer 250+ ...'; 220637272707 — 'using a low-MOQ manufacturer like Praxera'; 220640208499 — 'Low-MOQ private label programs from manufacturers like Praxera'; 220637279599 — 'With a manufacturing supplier like Praxera'; 220637279628 — 'Praxera ® Labs is a leader in nutrition, product development, and research. Our formulations develop from ...'; 220637279633 — 'Our products are doctor-formulated'; 220640208488 — 'At Praxera, we make sure to stay up-to-date on changing regulations'. Forbidden per brief: 'we produce', 'our facilities', 'we manufacture', 'our manufacturers'.
proposed_fix: Rewrite to partner/supplier framing, e.g. 'Praxera partners with FDA-registered, NSF GMP 455-2 certified manufacturing facilities in the U.S.' and 'a private label partner like Praxera' instead of 'a manufacturer like Praxera'. Drop 'our facilities'/'our formulations'/'we produce'.

title: 'FDA-certified facility' claim on 2 posts (FDA does not certify facilities)
evidence: 4 occurrences across 2 posts: 'all of our facilities are FDA-certified', 'Praxera offers over 50 years of experience, FDA-certified facilities...', 'Your manufacturer should ... have an FDA-certified facility', 'FDA-certified facilities, passing inspections...'. FDA registers and inspects dietary-supplement facilities; it does not certify them. Note post 220637272704 uses the correct phrasing ('FDA-registered').
proposed_fix: Replace every 'FDA-certified' with 'FDA-registered' (and 'cGMP-certified' where a third-party GMP certification is meant).

(2) At cutover, add 301s for blog.davincilabs.com/private-label/<slug> -> www.praxerasupplements.com/blog/<slug> for all 75 slugs, and hand-map this one because a 1:1 pattern rule would send the -2024 URL to a 404.
